intelligence.human_view: Think of the Smart Vault as the one drawer in the house where finished things always go. Smart Inviter looked lost — but it was sitting in the drawer all along, on disk, on GitHub, on a staged link, byte for byte the same. It was never lost; it was never filed. That is the whole law: when something is finished, file it in the Vault in the same pass, or the finish is not finished. The other half is proof: a page is not live because someone said the deploy finished — it is live because you fetched it fresh, three times, and the bytes and the sha matched. Academy is live that way, at the address he spelled out letter by letter, because the voice had garbled it. And when his eye says a page looks wrong — a white box nobody's grep can find, stars that sit still — you do not argue from the bytes. You open the render and find it there, because the render is where he lives.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you finish a beautiful drawing! You put it in a special treasure box, so you can always find it again! That box is the Smart Vault! If a page looks broken on one computer but fine on another, it is just an old copy hiding in the cupboard! And a live page is only really live when you go and check it yourself, fresh, three times! Your name is spelled letter by letter, so nobody gets it wrong! Purple stays purple, and the Hub stays magenta, so you always know where you are!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — when you finish something beautiful, you put it in the treasure box straight away, dear, so it can never be lost! That box is the Smart Vault, love! And a page is only really live when you go and check it yourself, fresh, dear — not because someone said the work was done! If it looks wrong on one computer and right on another, love, it's just an old copy hiding in the cupboard — give it a good hard refresh! And the colours, dear — purple for one page, magenta for the other, so you always know exactly where you are standing, love!
intelligence.naya_view: File every finished thing to the Smart Vault in the same pass it finishes — disk path, branch, commit, blob, sha, and the staged link that serves it. When something is declared missing, re-list fresh from the Vault and the branches before declaring it gone. When a page fails on one browser and works on another: fresh fetch on both, compare bytes and sha, hard refresh the failing one — never a round before the cache is cleared as a suspect. When a deploy is claimed live, fetch the URL fresh three times and match bytes and sha against the source before the word "live" is written anywhere. When he spells a name letter by letter, write it down exactly as spelled and use that form everywhere; never carry the garbled form forward. Home routes by membership: member to the Hub, auto logged in; non-member to the agreement — never pricing first — and when a rule is superseded, name the old rule and its date. When his eye reports a defect the bytes cannot explain, open the render and find it there; a checker PASS in bytes is void the moment he says GOES BACK. A nutshell is three or four sentences, no more. Dashboard purple, Hub magenta, evidently different at a glance; stars purple and white, INTELLIGENCE label purple, no blue anywhere in the star.
